a.xlink:title: An interface of default utility methods for implementing in-place operations.
Base class for IP_ (in-place) op codes.
Base class for I_ (index based) and IIP_ (index based in-place) op codes.
A "mixin" interface to generate bytecodes for operations on Ecstasy 128-bit integer types.
IP_DEC lvalue-target ; in-place decrement; no result.
IP_INC lvalue-target ; in-place increment; no result.
IP_DECA lvalue-target, lvalue ; T– -> T.
IP_INCA lvalue-target, lvalue ; T++ -> T.
IP_DECB lvalue-target, lvalue ; –T -> T.
IP_INCB lvalue-target, lvalue ; ++T -> T.
Base class for I_ (index based) and IIP_ (index based in-place) op codes.
IIP_DEC rvalue-target, rvalue-ix ; –T[ix] (no result).
IIP_INC rvalue-target, rvalue-ix ; ++T[ix] (no result).
IIP_DECA rvalue-target, rvalue-ix, lvalue ; T[ix]– -> T.
IIP_INCA rvalue-target, rvalue-ix, lvalue ; T[ix]++ -> T.
IIP_DECB rvalue-target, rvalue-ix, lvalue ; –T[ix] -> T.
IIP_INCB rvalue-target, rvalue-ix, lvalue ; ++T[ix] -> T.
I_GET rvalue-target, rvalue-ix, lvalue ; T = T[ix].
I_SET rvalue-target, rvalue-ix, rvalue ; T[ix] = T.
IIP_ADD rvalue-target, rvalue-ix, rvalue2 ; T[ix] += T.
IIP_AND rvalue-target, rvalue-ix, rvalue2 ; T[ix] &= T.
IIP_DIV rvalue-target, rvalue-ix, rvalue2 ; T[ix] *= T.
IIP_MOD rvalue-target, rvalue-ix, rvalue2 ; T[ix] %= T.
IIP_MUL rvalue-target, rvalue-ix, rvalue2 ; T[ix] *= T.
IIP_OR rvalue-target, rvalue-ix, rvalue2 ; T[ix] |= T.
IIP_SHL rvalue-target, rvalue-ix, rvalue2 ; T[ix] <<= T.
IIP_SHR rvalue-target, rvalue-ix, rvalue2 ; T[ix] >>= T.
IIP_SHRALL rvalue-target, rvalue-ix, rvalue2 ; T[ix] %= T.
IIP_SUB rvalue-target, rvalue-ix, rvalue2 ; T[ix] -= T.
IIP_XOR rvalue-target, rvalue-ix, rvalue2 ; T[ix] ^= T.
